description: Use this when the user asks about one of their websites or APIs: is it up, why is it down, what is checked on it, when its certificate or domain expires. Returns status and last check; its content checks, dependencies and cron jobs (children, each with when it last and next runs, and a check's interval); SSL and domain expiry; anomaly detection; maintenance now and in the next 7 days; and open incidents; with include, its DNS records and DNS watches, the subdomains found in certificate logs, or the certificates those logs list for its domain and which issuers it expects. Not for past checks or uptime over a range: use get_monitor_history or get_report.

include.description: Extra sections: dns (the site's records and its DNS watches), subdomains (names found in certificate logs), certificates (certificates those logs list for the site's domain, and its certificate alert).

site.description: The site's id, name or part of its URL.

name: get_site
title: Get one site
